items.html: And the secret of the matter: know that all the Klipot were made only from the sediments and the clarifications of the seven kings who died, as is known. And behold, those seven kings who died are only the aspect of ZON of Atzilut, because the kings of Aba and Ima did not die, as is mentioned by us, for they remained above in the place of Atzilut and did not descend to the world of Beriah. And therefore there was no death in them. But the seven kings of ZON, who descended to Beriah and died there — or were aroused and became the Klipot called death.
